_why: XbSymbolDatabase does not cover XMV, the video library, so these five
addresses had no names and the HLE replacements in src/hle/hle_xmv.c
could not bind. The title runs its own lifted decoder instead, and stops
after reading 128 KB of a 1 MB intro movie with the main thread idle at
3% on-CPU -- its hottest lifted function, sub_00447EC9, sits inside this
section.
Found twice over, by two methods that agree:
1. scripts/section_calls.py titles/futureperfect XMV, which reports the
calls crossing into the section from outside. It names seven entry
points with their argument counts, all called from 0x00030280.
2. tools.xdk_port_symbols, which carries a signature from a title where
the name is known. Black is the only title in this library whose XMV
the database names, and four of these five addresses came back from
it independently and identically. Black is D3D8LTCG and this title is
plain D3D8, so a full-length signature matched only one of the five;
at twenty bytes four matched, and the gaps between them are identical
to Black's -- Create to Destroy 0x544, Destroy to GetStreamInfo 0xE4
-- which is what the same library laid out by the same linker looks
like.
XMVPlaybackStart is the one signature matching could not carry, because
LTCG folded callers into Black's copy. It is identified here by argument
count and by what it does: the only unmatched one-argument entry point,
sitting immediately before Update exactly as in Black, and eleven bytes
long --
mov  eax, [esp+4]        ; the playback handle
mov  byte [eax+0x78], 1  ; the playing flag
ret  4
0x004450C2 (five arguments) is named XMVPlaybackCreateAudioStream here. The
XDK's own name for it is not known; the name says what it does. The title
calls it straight after Create with the handle, three zeros and an output
slot, and passes the result to IDirectSoundStream_SetVolume; the library
body reads the playback object at +0x4C and +0x130..+0x138 and calls
DirectSoundCreateStream. Left lifted against the HLE's playback object it
divided by zero inside DirectSound the moment the movie opened, so it is
replaced (see hle_xmv.c). Its replacement answers with a NULL stream, which
the title tests for before SetVolume and again before Flush and Release.
One entry point is deliberately left unnamed: 0x00445241 (two arguments,
storing its second at [handle+0x130], so a setter). It is not implemented
in hle_xmv.c and naming it would be a guess; the HLE's object is sized so
that store lands inside it.
Addresses are per title, not per XDK version: a statically linked library
lands wherever the linker put it. Only the behaviour is shared.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreateAudioStream
symbols._note: 0x004450C2. Five arguments. Descriptive name, not a documented XDK export; see _why.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackStart
symbols._note: 0x00445252. One argument; sets the playing flag at handle+0x78 and returns. See _why above for how this one was identified.
